seo.title: About — Alder Health
seo.description: Alder Health is a fictional outpatient network built to show how booking care can feel calm and practical. Meet the example clinics and clinicians.

intro.title: A local network. A human connection.
intro.lead: Alder brings outpatient appointments and video consultations together, so you can choose the right setting for your day.

network.heading: Care that stays close to home.
paragraphs: Alder Health is a fictional outpatient network. It exists to show how finding a clinician, choosing a time and preparing for a visit can feel calm and practical rather than administrative.
Every clinician, clinic, credential and appointment time on this site is an illustrative example. Nothing here books real care.

image.alt: A person walking towards the timber and stone entrance of an Alder Health clinic.

items.name: Alder Riverside Clinic
items.copy: Primary care and family medicine appointments, with a step-free entrance and a quiet waiting area.

items.name: Alder Northside Clinic
items.copy: Dermatology and primary care appointments, a short walk from the Northside transit stop.

video.heading: Video consultations.
video.copy: Choose video in the visit selector to explore example video availability. You will need a suitable device and a private place to talk. The clinic can help you check whether a video consultation is suitable for your visit.

notice.title: Fictional healthcare network
notice.copy: Alder Health is a design demonstration. The clinics, clinicians, availability and patient records shown across this site are illustrative examples only.
